scope: Adjacent bigram/trigram extraction and caller-supplied reference frequencies; no association scores

input_contract.selectors: Four distinct existing columns in a plain data.frame; extras ignored
input_contract.strings: Plain nonempty valid UTF-8 character; no NA; terms contain no Unicode whitespace
input_contract.positions: Finite positive whole numbers <= 2^53 - 1; strictly increasing within a contiguous document/segment block
input_contract.n: Nonempty ordered unique selection of integer 2 and 3
input_contract.documents: Optional unique ordered character roster containing all input IDs; defaults to first-seen IDs; may include empty documents
input_contract.preprocessing_id: Required caller label covering segmentation, lexical units, exclusions and normalization; equality is necessary but not evidence of actual preparation equivalence
input_contract.adjacency: Same document, same explicit segment, consecutive original positions; overlapping windows retained; no sorting
input_contract.boundary_evidence: Caller-supplied; no automatic sentence, punctuation or removed-span reconstruction
input_contract.normalization: None; exact UTF-8 component equality; composed and decomposed Unicode remain distinct
input_contract.max_ngrams: Positive whole bound on occurrence rows before occurrence table/tally allocation; default 1000000; not a whole-result or memory bound

extraction.occurrences_order: Requested n then input start-row order
extraction.counts_order: First occurrence of each exact component tuple; document_counts includes document ID in the tuple
extraction.documents_order: Roster document order then requested n
extraction.totals_documents: Number of roster documents, including zero-token documents

reference.counts: Unique observed n/component keys; positive whole occurrence/document counts; document_count <= count and <= declared documents; extra columns dropped
reference.totals: Required unique n rows for an external table; nonnegative whole opportunities and documents; positive opportunities require positive documents; whole values <= 2^53 - 1
reference.complete_default: TRUE from unmodified extraction; FALSE from external table
reference.complete_validation: For each n, sum(count) = opportunities when complete, <= opportunities otherwise; declared completeness remains a caller assertion
reference.absence_complete: not_observed: count 0 and document_count 0 within declared sample
reference.absence_incomplete: not_listed: count NA and document_count NA
reference.metadata_evidence: Caller assertions, not license or population/compatibility certification

profile.summary_order: Document roster then requested n then token/type
profile.compatible_inputs: Unmodified extraction/reference results; equal preprocessing_id; reference totals for every target n
profile.rate: reference_count / reference_opportunities_for_n * 1000000; NA if opportunities = 0 or count is missing
profile.weighting: Token: all target occurrences; type: one copy per exact n/component sequence within document
profile.eligible_items: Target occurrences or types, including absent reference keys
profile.listed_items: Number of eligible items whose reference_status is listed
profile.zero_items: Number whose reference_status is not_observed, including when zero reference opportunities leave the rate undefined
profile.unavailable_items: Number with missing rate; may overlap zero_items when reference opportunities are zero
profile.lookup_coverage: listed_items / eligible_items; NA for empty target
profile.value_coverage: (eligible_items - unavailable_items) / eligible_items; NA for empty target
profile.mean: Arithmetic mean of available rates, including defined complete-reference zeros; no available values gives NA
profile.ok: At least one available value, potentially partial coverage; missing_reason is NA_character_

storage.double: All positions, counts, rates and coverages
storage.character: IDs, terms, statuses, missing reasons, weighting
storage.term3: NA_character_ for bigrams; valid nonempty term for trigrams
storage.empty: Zero-document tables preserve column order and types; requested n still appears in extraction/reference totals

identity.content_sha256: digest SHA-256 over the complete classed result with its own provenance$content_sha256 removed, R serialization version 2
identity.input_sha256: digest SHA-256 over list(document IDs, segment IDs, double positions, terms, document roster), R serialization version 2
identity.purpose: RDS replay and accidental-change detection; not security signatures or permission verification
identity.profile_provenance: Retains full target and reference provenance and reference totals
identity.disclosure: Terms and document/segment IDs are present in returned tables; no automatic external transmission

print: At most 12 rows of documents, totals or summary respectively; returns complete x invisibly
